recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-panel composition featuring a large, moody duotone portrait on the left and a vertical stack of three smaller portraits on the right, separated by a thin color-blocked divider.
coreVisualRelationships: Asymmetrical balance between a dominant left image and a repetitive right column
Chromatic tension between cool blue-toned photography and vibrant primary color accents
Geometric division using a vertical strip of red, green, and purple
Typographic integration within the negative space of the primary portrait
coreInvariants: Blue-cyan duotone or monochrome photographic treatment

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Primary subject occupies the left two-thirds; secondary subjects are scaled down and stacked vertically on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large portrait on the left serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the large portrait to the text, then down the vertical color strip to the secondary portraits.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper right quadrant of the main portrait provides a dark, textured area for text placement.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep cyan and navy blue duotone for all photography.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White highlights in the photography and text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure red, emerald green, and royal purple in the vertical divider strip.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast in photography with low saturation; high saturation in the geometric color blocks.
paletteRestrictions: Limit accents to primary/secondary solid blocks

characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended horizontal bars used as decorative underlines or dividers
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used with varying colors and horizontal line accents.

candidateDirections.reason: Classic high-contrast serif with elegant proportions
Standard Roman skeleton that matches the sharp serif profile

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 2:3 ratio layout with a large blue-toned duotone portrait on the left and three smaller blue-toned portraits stacked on the right. Place a vertical strip of red, green, and purple between the sections.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase serif text in the upper-left quadrant using wide tracking and thin horizontal red lines above and below the text blocks.

verificationChecks: Are the three color blocks (red, green, purple) present?
Is the text a high-contrast serif in all-caps?

adjustableVariables: Duotone color (e.g., sepia instead of blue)
Number of stacked portraits on the right
Specific colors in the divider strip
mustRedesign: Avoid exact facial features of the original subjects
Do not use the specific brand name or band title
postGenerationChecks: Check for vertical alignment of the right-hand stack
Ensure the color strip is perfectly straight
Verify the duotone effect is uniform across all images
Confirm the serif text has sufficient tracking
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Duotone Portraiture] + [Vertical Color Block Strip] + [High-Contrast Serif Typography] with [Asymmetrical Grid Layout].
